name: F1® Box
image_description: F1 Box racing simulator installation with red and violet LED arches and screens
challenge: Make a racing activation feel like an entire immersive world, with visuals, audio, lighting and results working together.
how_disguise_helps: Designer, an EX 3+ media server and Disguise services connect the room. A leaderboard brings race data into the experience in real time.
outcome: From a pixel-accurate 3D preview to on-site programming, one workflow connects the pre-production vision to the guest experience.
note: Sources: supplied deck, slides 20–21; public Disguise F1 Box article. Photo: Ian Wallman.
